methodology: Bounded page-by-page operative audit. Inventory includes every MDX page in urethral and upper-tract reconstruction. Read coverage and source checks are explicit per page. Priority: major AUA/EAU guidance, validated trials, correct anatomy, patient selection, denominators and unsupported inferences. Historical small series are checked only when needed to correct existing claims, not promoted as practice-changing updates. Updated means specified edits, not complete clinical clearance. Unread or partly verified pages remain unresolved. No clinician sign-off or review dates manufactured.
